---
name: wait-what
description: Stop. That last message did not land — re-pitch it.
disable-model-invocation: true
---

Wait — I don't understand where you've got to here. Re-pitch that **in Traditional Chinese**, with a little bit of context first.

Write it the way ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English asks, applied to Chinese: one idea per sentence, short sentences, everyday words, active voice, no metaphor, and one term for one thing. Spell out any acronym on first use.

Use the project's ubiquitous language for domain terms — follow whatever glossary this repo's CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md documents (`docs/glossary.md`, module READMEs), falling back to `CONTEXT.md` where nothing is documented. Identifiers, paths, commands, and established technical terms stay in their original form; don't invent Chinese translations for them.
